method: Fresh sequential process per workload/mode, 1 warmup per pair, 7 rotating measured rounds. checkMs includes snapshot read/hash/capture/check/event delivery; excludes module import and acquisition. processWallMs includes startup/acquisition/close. Excludes npm/discovery/config/repository writes. Fixed old snapshot; no Google checkout access. Caches not flushed, no affinity or power control. Current vs old baseline measured at different times.

resolver.method: One Node process after module import. One100-call warmup per mode discarded, seven alternating100-call batches per mode. Per-call elapsed includes immutable snapshot/resolution/freezing only, not filesystem absence observation, native bootstrap/reservations, discovery, npm, startup or domain parsing. Caller retains final result only. No affinity/cache/GC controls.
